parts.text:
Fixed. `parse_amount` now removes thousands separators before it checks the amount pattern:

```python
text = text.replace(",", "")
if not _AMOUNT_RE.match(text):
```

The line goes after the parentheses check, so "(1,234.50)" also parses as -1234.50. All 14 tests pass (`python -m pytest --cov=invoice_tools`). The DeprecationWarning from `totals.py` was already there and is not related to this change.
